name: Tabloid Headline
tagline: ravyn's headline: the face 94 % of the time, red Anton shout words rising through a mask, Playfair whispers, no music.

motion.direction: ravyn `headline`. A tabloid talking head: the face stays on screen 94 % of the time, no punch-ins. Red `ter` Anton SHOUT words (180–205 px, 1–2 words) rise through a mask in 3–11 frames; a Playfair italic whisper line (≈105 px) answers them; captions are Playfair bold phrases hard-swapped every ~0.9 s. Paper `mar` cards with a dotted grid hold B&W `imageCard`s; a black badge `stamp` for the verdict. NO music, NO SFX, hard cuts only. Rapid speech, ~220 wpm feel.
